description_en: Modifies the security audit settings of an interactive messaging application
description_zh: 修改互动消息应用安全审核设置
kebab_example: aliyun live modify-live-message-app-audit --app-id demo --audit-type 2 --audit-url http://example.aliyundoc.com/exampleaudit --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyLiveMessageAppAudit

parameters.description_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application to modify.
parameters.description_zh: 需要修改信息的互动消息应用ID。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application to modify
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改信息的互动消息应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en:
The security audit method. Valid values:
- 0: No security audit.
- 1: Built-in security audit.
- 2: Custom security audit.
parameters.description_zh:
安全审核方式。取值：
- 0：不进行安全审核
- 1：内置安全审核
- 2：自定义安全审核
parameters.help_en:
The security audit method. Valid values:
- 0: No security audit.
- 1: Built-in security audit.
- 2: Custom security audit
parameters.help_zh:
安全审核方式。取值：
- 0：不进行安全审核
- 1：内置安全审核
- 2：自定义安全审核
parameters.name: audit_type

parameters.description_en: The security audit URL required when custom security audit is used (AuditType=2). The URL must start with http:// or https://, must not contain private IP addresses, and must not include port numbers.
parameters.description_zh: 如果是自定义安全审核（AuditType=2），则需要提供安全审核的地址。安全审核地址以http://或https://开头，不包含私有IP，不允许带端口号。
parameters.help_en: The security audit URL required when custom security audit is used (AuditType=2). The URL must start with http:// or https://, must not contain private IP addresses, and must not include port numbers
parameters.help_zh: 如果是自定义安全审核（AuditType=2），则需要提供安全审核的地址。安全审核地址以http://或https://开头，不包含私有IP，不允许带端口号
parameters.name: audit_url

parameters.description_en: The data center. This value must be the same as the data center specified in [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~). Valid values: cn-shanghai (Shanghai) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).
parameters.description_zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
parameters.help_en: The data center. This value must be the same as the data center specified in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html. Valid values: cn-shanghai (Shanghai) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center
